title: Spectral Mist

outfit_card.silhouette: An off-shoulder gown with a fitted corset bodice, an asymmetric draped skirt that cascades into a feathered train, and voluminous white fur stole layered over the arms and back for a dramatic ballroom silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An intricate silver floral comb with dark sapphire crystals and petite pearl accents, positioned in an elegant up-swept hair style.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless navy velvet bodice with a sweetheart neckline, enriched by a delicate silver chain and beadwork overlay. The sleeves are formed by a plush white fur stole that wraps around the shoulders and arms, with sheer black lace gloves visible beneath.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: The skirt features tiered layers of iridescent blue-black organza and chiffon, draped asymmetrically with a prominent white fabric rose at the hip. The hem extends into a dramatic, feather-like train, paired with lace-trimmed stockings and elegant dark pointed heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A flock of floating, ethereal blue butterflies flutters around the ensemble, with a subtle mist-like aura and scattered floral petals enhancing the magical, nightly atmosphere.
